title: The Flattened Flowerbed
crime: During the Mesa Rally someone cut across the flowerbed and flattened it. Every racer told the marshal their lap's average speed, and one of them lied.
deed: you cut across the flowerbed during the rally and flattened it, then told the marshal a false speed.
oath: My rally lap averaged {value} {unit}. Check the board.
measure: The lab reads each racer's distance and time off the timing log.
hint: *Average speed is distance divided by time. Which number goes on top?
arrive: Motion Mesa, and the flowerbed by the rally track is squashed flat. The Baron erased the law of speed.
Three racers. Each one told the marshal their lap's average speed.
Question them, then check the timing log.
inspect: Tyre tracks straight through the flowers. Somebody took a shortcut.
The timing log has every lap's distance and time. Speed tells on whoever lied.
confession: Okay, okay! I cut through the flowers. The Baron said speed couldn't be checked any more.
